page.layout: Two printed pages on the scan. Left page: one column of running text, dictionary entries, with the page number 270 at top left and the running head KO at top centre. Right page: a narrow margin of notes along the right edge, set in small type and partly cut off by the scan edge, with the number 10 at its top.

main_text.p: Th. κῶλαξ ακῶς ὁ parasitus, gnatho, adu-lator.
Κολαφίζω alapam alicui infringo, colaphum infligo. F. ίσω. P. κεκολάφικα. a.1. ἐκολάφισα. pras. pass. κολαφίζομαι ἡ ἐπὶ colaphis cador. ἀ κολαφος ἢ ὁ colaphus. Th. κολάτω tundo.

Κολλάω ῶ glutino (ἀ κόλλα ης ἡ gluten.) F. ήσω. P. κεκόλλημαι. pras. pass. κολλώμενος ὦμαι aglutinor, adhæreo, cum Dativ. infin. pass. κολλᾶσθαι ἀλλ Actor. s. v.13. part. præs. κολλώμενος ὦ adhærescens. aorist. 1. pass. ἐκολλήθην ης ἡ adhæsi. part. aor. 1. pass. κολληθεὶς ἐντὸς ὁ.
Κολλύριον seu κολλύριον ἢ τὸ collyrium, Apoc. 3. v.18.
Κολλυβιστὴς ἢ ὁ numularius, collybista, trapezita. Th. κολλύβῳ ἢ ὁ numulus, obulus.
Κολοβόω ῶ contraho, decurto, amputo. F. ώσω. P. κεκολόβωκα. a.1. ἐκολόβωσα. a.1. pass. ἐκολοβώθην ης ἡ. fut.1. pass. κολοβωθήσομαι ἡ ἐπὶ. Th. κολοβὸς ἢ ὁ ἡ mancus, mutilus a.
Κόλπος ἢ ὁ sinus, gremium. Per metaph. Act. 27. v.39. maris sinus.
Κολυμβάω ῶ nato. F. ήσω. P. κεκολύμβηκα.
Κολυμβήθρα ας ἡ locus, ubi natare possumus, piscina, Joh. 5. 2.
Κόμη ης ἡ coma, cæsaries, promissi capilli.
Κομάω ῶ comatus sum, comam more mulierum alo. F. ήσω. P. κεκόμηκα.
Κομίζω fero. Fut. ίσω. P. κεκόμικα. aor. 1. ἐκόμισα. præs.

page.notes: The right margin is a narrow strip of small, cropped notes (Hebrew, Greek and Latin glosses, cross-references such as "Hebr. 11. 39.", and words like "quiesco", "planto", "laboro", "cædo") that are largely cut off at the scan edge; they are not legible enough to transcribe word for word, so they are not reproduced here. The Greek forms in the entries are copied from the scan and some accents may be uncertain. Several Greek words in the entries are partly blurred and may contain errors.
